name: SwiftDrome
subtitle: A SwiftUI client for Navidrome and Subsonic-API music servers.
description:
SwiftDrome is an iOS client for Subsonic-API-compatible music servers (primarily Navidrome), built with SwiftUI and Apple's Liquid Glass design language.

Log in to your own Navidrome/Subsonic server and browse your library: artists, albums, playlists, genres, and search. Stream playback with a queue engine that keeps a user-controlled "Play Next" stack separate from the main queue, plus favorites and back-skip history.

This source publishes unsigned .ipa builds automatically whenever a change is released, so the version here should always track the latest build.
